text:
maria_cs: Weekly health check-in for AcmeCorp — quick error-rate snapshot before renewal review next Tue. Flagging spike in 5xx/timeouts tied to onboarding flows. TL;DR: overall error rate 3.6% (+1.1pt w/w), breakdown -> 5xx 48%, timeouts 32%, rate-limited 20%. Top failing endpoints below, please ACK and add remediation ETAs.

alex_sre: Saw the spike at ~09:12 UTC, autoscaler didn't add capacity fast enough during the onboarding burst. Queue backlog + long seqs causing KV cache pressure. Quick raw counts from logs:```
/v1/generate 820 errors (5xx & timeouts combined)
/v1/stream 420 timeouts
/v1/embeddings 210 rate_limit responses
/v1/auth/callback 60 5xx (upstream auth timeout)
/v1/batch 40 5xx
```

kim_onboard: We're running a promo so new users are hitting long-context generation templates — many >4096 tokens. Can we prioritize short-circuiting long jobs or encourage condensed prompts in the quickstart? Noted lots of calls from onboarding org id: acct-ACME-9.

raj_support: Customer ticket #CS-12481 reports:. "generation failed with 500" repeatedly this morning, customer says multiple attempts in a row. They asked for ETA and are concerned ahead of renewal. I've shared a short transcript with them.

maria_cs: Thanks — two immediate asks: 1) SRE to add temporary headroom + fallback policy (alex) 2) Product/DevEx to enable a per-customer temp quota bump and update quickstart guidance (kim) 3) CS will set expectation with Acme, offer to monitor and provide credits if SLA impact persists (raj/maria).

alex_sre: Will add +2x autoscale headroom for Acme pool and enable model-fallback to smaller quantized variant for requests >2048 tokens. ETA ~2h. Also toggling stricter request timeouts on streaming endpoints to limit queueing.

deploy-bot: autoscaler policy updated by alex_sre at 1769154321 (change-id: ap-7721) :white_check_mark:

kim_onboard: I'll push a one-line note in the quickstart to encourage <2048 tokens and link a sample condensed prompt. Also can we surface token length warnings in the onboarding dashboard?

alex_sre: Agree on length warnings — can add a lightweight middleware check that returns 413-like response with a hint. Low-risk change, ETA 1d.

raj_support: Looping in account owner (cc: @acme-pm) in the customer thread and offering a monitoring window. Customer ok with temporary mitigations but wants resolution before renewal discussion.

maria_cs: Renewal risk = MEDIUM for now (impact to onboarding). Updating renewal tracker with mitigation plan + SRE ETA. Please ping here once autoscale/fallback confirmed. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
